candidates.title: DeathScreen Replay Proof Presenter Extraction
candidates.axis: speed / organization / efficiency / ui / ux / user-experience / security
candidates.why: Current code correctly turns replay trace evidence into receipts and a last-10 trend, but `DeathScreen.jsx` still owns the composition of the current receipt, history trend, and share-card stamp. That makes a trust contract depend on a large React component and raises the chance that future UI edits silently desync the proof card from the generated share image. A pure presenter helper keeps replay trust copy, trend math, and share-card text in one tested place while preserving the player-facing DeathScreen behavior.
candidates.recipe: Create `src/utils/replayProofPresenter.js` with `buildReplayProofPresenter({ traceEvidence, runHistory })`, returning `receipt`, `trend`, and `shareStamp`. Replace inline DeathScreen receipt/trend composition with the helper and add focused tests covering no evidence, rich evidence, and mixed recent proof history.

L1.recipe: Extract only DeathScreen receipt/trend creation into a pure helper and cover rich/no-evidence cases.

L2.recipe: Add receipt, trend, and shareStamp output; wire DeathScreen card and score-card canvas to use it; test rich evidence plus mixed history.

L3.recipe: Also normalize submit feedback proof receipts through the presenter so online/local/rejected states can surface the same trust language.

candidates.title: Repo-Local Ops Innovation Pack Command
candidates.axis: speed / organization / efficiency / token / api consumption reduction
candidates.why: The local session protocol tells `/implement` to expand into an innovation pack when the audit list is exhausted, but `node scripts/ops.mjs innovation-pack` currently exits as an unknown command. That makes low-context continuation loops depend on agent improvisation instead of a repo-local executable surface. A small command that writes `docs/INNOVATION_PACK.md` restores the protocol contract and reduces future token waste from rediscovering the same missing helper.
candidates.recipe: Add an `innovation-pack` command to `scripts/ops.mjs` that gathers open Now/Deferred task-board items plus cached genius-list signals, writes `docs/INNOVATION_PACK.md`, and documents guardrails for repo-local implementation candidates.

L1.recipe: Add a help entry and command stub that prints the cached genius-list output.

L2.recipe: Generate `docs/INNOVATION_PACK.md` from task-board and genius-list signals, then smoke-test the command.

L3.recipe: Also wire protocol drift coverage so the generated innovation-pack artifact remains visible in future checks.
